prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Certificate First Adoption Flow Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a spotlight layout with interactive badge and signature input before finalizing photo upload. (why: Adoption step conversion drops to 69.4% with a high mean duration of 1017s, indicating user hesitation during pet customization details.)
1: [home, hint] Desktop Visibility Status Check Hint: Adds explicit diagnostic troubleshooting text and checklist components to the waiting screen if the app stalls during rendering. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop or the app failing to open during initial launch.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Direct Path Decision Clarity Copy: Rewrites choose_path headlines and helper microcopy to clearly distinguish between instant companion creation and deep custom creation. (why: While median path selection is fast (8s), the mean selection time is 514s, indicating confusion for undecided users.)
3: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Pet Selection Preview: Changes pick_friend screen layout to split view, showcasing companion archetypes and live trait previews side-by-side. (why: Adoption stage has high dropoff (69.4% conversion) and a long mean time of 1017s.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Rendering Status & Notification Switch: Enables push notification alerts and dynamic time estimates on the waiting screen while background generation finishes. (why: Home step waiting time has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to abandon or lose track of completion.)
5: [choose_path, notification] Story Overview Progress Reminder: Adds progress bar indicators and step counters to the story screen to drive momentum early in onboarding. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 29.6%, calling for strong progress signals early in the flow.)
